title: Go guerrilla: go-guerrilla crashes on a bare XCLIENT command (7-byte slice off-by-one panic) (CVE-2026-115578)
description: A vulnerability in the go-guerrilla SMTP server allows a remote unauthenticated client to crash the SMTP daemon by sending a bare XCLIENT command without arguments. This triggers a slice bounds out-of-range panic due to an off-by-one error in command parsing when the xclient_on feature is enabled. The panic occurs in the per-connection goroutine without recovery, causing the entire server process to crash.
